children: Ramelius Resources' better-than-expected medium-term production outlook offsets higher costs and near-term cash flow constraints, according to Macquarie. The gold miner's FY 2029-2030 production forecasts are up to 12% higher than consensus. Macquarie keeps a neutral rating and 4.00 Australian dollar target on the stock. It says it thinks Ramelius's shares are fairly valued, trading at roughly 9.0x FY 2027 enterprise value/Ebitda estimates. Macquarie cautions that higher capital expenditure will limit near-term cash flow generation. Shares are up 3.4% at A$3.93, adding to Monday's 6.2% gain. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
